tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250thugs dam zab pa skor bdun gyi bka' srung gza'i skong gsol las byang ni/ 1$0000300

dang po spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐/ gsang bdag rta mchog dpal dang rig 'dzin gtso// padma thod phreng spyan sngar khas blangs pa'i// dregs pa'i gtso bo mthu stobs kun gyi bdag /lha chen rā hu la khyod gshegs su gsol/ khyed kyi 'khor tshogs gza' brgyad gdong mo bzhi// rgyu skar snang srid lha 'dre dregs pa'i tshogs// phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad pho brang so so nas// skad cig yud tsam la ni gshegs su gsol// bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐/ dgra bgegs zhing chen padma'i gdan khri la// mi srun dregs pa'i gtso bo 'khor bcas rnams// sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po bsrung ba'i phyir// mi g.yo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol// mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ phyi nang gsang gsum bdud rtsi rakta'i tshogs// dmar chen gtor ma dgra bo'i sha khrag rus// za byed bstan srung 'khor bcas zhal du khā hi// phrin las bcol ba ni/ hūm̐/ sngon gyi dam bcas thugs dam ji bzhin du// sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po bsrung ba dang*// rnal 'byor sgrub pa po yi grogs mdzad phyir// dam bcas bzhin du bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// bstod pa ni/ hrīḥ dug lnga las grub srid pa kun gyi bdag /za byed rngams pa lus dmar mig stong ldan// chu srin rgyal mtshan rwa yi mda' gzhu 'dzin// bstan dgra thal bar rlag mdzad khyed la bstod/ khyed kyi 'khor tshogs gza' brgyad gdong mo bzhi// rgyu skar snang srid 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs// legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod pa'i// bka' sdod bran g.yog tshogs la bdag bstod do// bskul ba ni/ hūm̐/ mthu stobs dregs pa'i gtso bo rā hu la/ skye 'gro'i srog bdag drag rtsal chen po khyed// 'khor bcas bskyod de dgra bo'i srog la bhyo// dam nyams dgra bo las ngan 'di nyid kyi// sha zo khrag thungs srog dbugs zhal du gsol// mi rgyud rtsad chod sa zhing thal bar thongs// ming tsam med par rdul du brlag par mdzod//

ces bskul bar bya'o// zhes pa 'di ni zur mkhar rdo'i mchod rten gyi shar phyogs nas dar zur phu ba kun dga' rgya mtsho/ phun tshogs sbyin pa gsum gyis bskul ba'i ngor bdag 'dra rdzogs chen pa gar gyi dbang phyug rtsal gyis sbyar ba dge legs su 'phel bar gyur cig/ //
